create_dialog_state: create a DialogState dataclass with step_id, episode data, and optional tool_executor for RL episodes
init_dialog_env: initialize a DialogEnv with an InstructTokenizer to set up message formatting and abbreviation tokens
truncate_message: truncate a MessageBase to a max token count from the left or right side using maybe_truncate
create_transition: create a Transition with messages as observation, handling EOT tokens and optional thinking start tokens
encode_prompt_dialog: encode a sequence of messages into token IDs using the DialogEnv tokenizer for RL observations
